notes.text: Explicit R. Ezra asked R. Mana about how often a voice must be heard, against the three nods required to establish intent.
Explicit R. Ezra raised a challenge to R. Mana about liability for setting another person’s stack alight on Shabbat.
Two addresses by R. Ezra to R. Mana concern uncertain-status terumah. The second pointer is in the same halakhah.
The final halakhah gives R. Ḥananiah and R. Ezra (עזרה) asking R. Mana. The other result at 1:1:12 mentions Ezra the Scribe and is unrelated.
The end of Shabbat chapter seven has R. Ezra speaking to R. Mana about the minimum measure used as kindling.
